_comment: Suspense and Intimidate are printed keywords (printed_keywords) and fire from the card DB keywords field - NOT authored here. Two separate TRIGGERED abilities on ON_LEAVE_PLAY: one for the intimidate (targeted, per release note 1), one for the +4{p} pump (MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK, not MODIFY_ATTACK, because no current attack exists when an aura leaves). ON_ENTER_PLAY and ON_LEAVE_PLAY are dispatched from Zone.add and destroy()'s leaves_arena event respectively. Known engine gap: leaving by BANISH or return-to-hand emits no leaves_arena event, so those routes don't fire the leave trigger today.
